note: Karayol et al. (2024) specifically demonstrated that while MOF and MSL3 variants cause reduced global H4K16ac, global bulk H4K16ac levels remain unchanged in MSL2 patient iPSCs.

evidence.text: In individuals with MSL2-related neurodevelopmental disorder, global bulk H4K16ac levels were unchanged in patient-derived iPSCs, unlike in other MSL complex-related disorders caused by MOF and MSL3 variants, which exhibit reduced global H4K16ac.

source.title: MSL2 variants lead to a neurodevelopmental syndrome with lack of coordination, epilepsy, specific dysmorphisms, and a distinct episignature
source.quote: Remarkably, while NDD-associated variants in two other members of the MSL complex (MOF and MSL3) result in reduced H4K16ac, global H4K16ac levels are unchanged in iPSCs with MSL2 variants.
